desc: Spin Dash (#51) meets walls as a run does: spun up into Petal Meadows' back edge, the stick held, Mario stops against it (its end by the wall, as Paper Mario's hitWallTime) on the meadow and runs on along it as the stick asks (the spin's forced run went straight through it, and he fell off the map)
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(a wall\): \d+ units in \d+ frames, at \(-300, 0, -1[34]\d\), then runs
